name: Marketing Consulting & Fractional CMO
promise: Senior marketing strategy, channel plans and team direction — without a full-time CMO.
intro: gaa-tha provides marketing consulting and fractional CMO support for US and UK brands and agencies: positioning, go-to-market plans, channel and budget strategy, creative direction and monthly performance reviews, with optional execution by our in-house team across ads, social, content, Shopify and web.

glance.bestFor: Founders and growing brands without a senior marketer; agencies needing strategy support
glance.timeline: Audit and plan in two to four weeks, then monthly advisory
glance.model: Fixed-scope strategy project or a monthly fractional retainer
glance.channels: Meta, Google, social, email, Shopify, marketplaces, content

whatIs: Marketing consulting is senior, outside advice on what to sell to whom, through which channels, with what budget and how to measure it. A fractional CMO goes further: a part-time marketing leader who owns the plan, directs the team or agencies and reviews results every month.

gaa-tha's founders lead strategy and brand thinking for the studio's clients in India and Canada. We offer the same as a consulting project or monthly fractional retainer for US and UK brands, and because we also execute, the plan can be delivered by our team or handed to yours.
included: Marketing audit: positioning, funnel, channels, creative and tracking
Go-to-market and channel plan with budget split
Agency and freelancer briefs and reviews
Monthly performance review and next-month priorities
Optional execution by the gaa-tha team

steps.title: Audit
steps.text: We review your numbers, funnel, channels, creative and competitors.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.text: Positioning, audience, channel mix, budget and KPIs written into one plan.

steps.title: Roadmap
steps.text: A 90-day roadmap with owners, whether your team, your agencies or ours.

steps.title: Direct
steps.text: Weekly or fortnightly working sessions in your business hours to steer execution.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Monthly review of results against KPIs and the next month's priorities.

pricing: Custom-quoted as a fixed-scope strategy project or a monthly fractional retainer. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.q: What does a fractional CMO do?
faq.a: A fractional CMO is a part-time marketing leader who sets strategy, owns the plan and budget, directs the team and agencies and reviews results monthly. gaa-tha offers this to US and UK brands on a monthly retainer.

faq.q: Is marketing consulting worth it before hiring an agency?
faq.a: Usually, yes. A clear strategy, KPIs and channel plan make every agency or hire more effective, and stop budget being spent on channels that do not fit your buyers.

faq.q: Can you also execute the plan?
faq.a: Yes. Our in-house team runs ads, social, content, Shopify and web work, but the plan is written so your own team or other agencies can deliver it too.
Yes. Agencies use us for strategy support on pitches and client plans, delivered under the agency's name.

faq.q: How do sessions work across time zones?
faq.a: We work US business hours, so working sessions and reviews happen during your day by video call.
With an audit and strategy project. If it is useful, it becomes a monthly fractional retainer.
